data.description:
## What
Add tests/brainstorm to the commands.test_dirs entry in .claude/dso-config.conf so the harness runs via test-batched.sh in CI.

## Why
Story f629-4fa9 DD3: without registration in commands.test_dirs, the brainstorm harness never runs in CI — tests can be created and ignored indefinitely.

## Acceptance Criteria
- .claude/dso-config.conf commands.test_dirs entry updated to include tests/brainstorm (colon-separated; currently: tests/hooks:tests/scripts:tests/acceptance)
- New value: tests/hooks:tests/scripts:tests/acceptance:tests/brainstorm
- test_runner_registration structural test goes GREEN after this change
- validate.sh --ci can invoke test-batched.sh with tests/brainstorm in the test-dir path

## Files to Modify
- .claude/dso-config.conf (commands.test_dirs line)

## testing_mode
GREEN
data.title: Register tests/brainstorm in dso-config.conf commands.test_dirs (f629-4fa9 DD3)
